title: Replica symmetry breaking at arbitrary depth
summary: We study finite-step replica symmetry breaking (RSB) in mixed $p$-spin Ising spin glasses at positive temperature and zero external field. For every integer $k\geq1$, we construct polynomial mixtures whose Parisi measures are exactly $k$-RSB, with each such phase persisting on an open set of coefficients. More generally, for a broad class of polynomial covariances with an $r$-RSB Parisi measure, adding the interaction term $λq^p$ for sufficiently large even $p$ produces a unique $r$-RSB-to-$(r+1)$-RSB transition as $λ$ varies near a critical value.
